official_title: 2026 Scholarship Applications Are Now Open for Prospective International Graduate Students of Peking University

degrees.quote: Chinese Government Scholarship covers 2-3 years for a master's and 4-5 years for a doctorate; PKUS 4 years for a doctorate; BGS 2-3 years master's and 4-5 years doctorate (as summarised from the official notice)

opens.source_text: Notice dated 12 January 2026: "Complete the Peking University online scholarship application (open now until Beijing Time 9:00a.m. on March 9)"; no opening date is stated.

closes.source_text: open now until Beijing Time 9:00a.m. on March 9; CSC application open now until Beijing Time at 24:00 on March 17

notes: The year is not printed beside 'March 9' or 'March 17'; 2026 is read from the notice title ('2026 Scholarship Applications') and the page date 12 January 2026. Downgrade to date_only/unconfirmed if you will not accept that.

The website's current opens value (26 October 2026 to 25 December 2026) is NOT supported by any official page I could reach. isd.pku.edu.cn/en/ home page and searches of pku.edu.cn show no 2027 notice; the only PKU graduate scholarship call published is the 2026 one (now closed). The Oct 26-Dec 25 2026 window may come from a source I could not find; it should be removed or its source re-checked.
CSC application on the same page closes midnight (24:00) Beijing Time on March 17 (year not printed).
id=730 ('2026 Application Information for International Students') returned 'content does not exist or has been deleted'.
Certificate download available from the Application Status page 'since February 25' (no year).

degrees.quote: Master's degree program applicants; Doctoral degree program applicants

closes.source_text: December 15, 2025: Deadline for 1st Round of Chinese Government Scholarship (apply through SJTU); February 15, 2026: Deadline for the Final Round of Chinese Government Scholarship; March 31, 2026: Deadline for the SGS Scholarship and SJTU Scholarship applications; May 31, 2026: Deadline for self-supported applications. Beijing Time; no hour given.

notes: Closing differs by scholarship: CGS 15 Dec 2025 (round 1) / 15 Feb 2026 (final round); SGS and SJTU Scholarship 31 Mar 2026; self-supported 31 May 2026. The website's single date 15 Feb 2026 is only the final CGS round, so route_dependent is more accurate (or keep 15 Feb 2026 as the CGS date).
No 2027 SJTU international graduate guide was found; searches only show 2026 guide and school-level 2027 pages (e.g. SAIF Round 1 on Dec 15, 2026), which are not this record.

official_title: Admission to Graduate Programs of Tsinghua University 2027 (For International Students)

degrees.quote: Tsinghua offers master's and doctoral programs across 54 schools and departments (as summarised from the official 2027 notice; page itself could not be fetched directly)

opens.source_text: Official 2027 notice/reminder: the international application system had not yet opened and is expected to be accessible 'from mid-September 2026 to February 2027'; application period generally 'from September to February of the following year'.

closes.source_text: Deadlines and application rounds for international graduate students differ by department/school and programme; see 'Remarks of Application' in each programme catalogue. Winter break 21 January to 17 February 2027 may delay verification.

notes: yz.tsinghua.edu.cn and www.tsinghua.edu.cn refused connections (ECONNREFUSED) from here, so page text was only available through search-tool summaries of the official pages 1581, 1582, 1583; exact quotes could not be re-read. Browser pane also failed.

Opening: the notice says the system was expected from mid-September 2026; I could not confirm whether it has actually opened as of 2026-10-23. Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School (sigs.tsinghua.edu.cn, 2026/0917 notice) says 2027 admissions are open, with closing 17:00 Beijing Time on May 15, 2027 (school-level, not general).
Programme-level examples from Tsinghua pages: Advanced Computing first round before Dec 15, 2026 17:00; Global MBA rounds 19 Oct 2026, 14 Dec 2026, 22 Feb 2027, 31 Mar 2027.
Related page 'https://yz.tsinghua.edu.cn/en/info/1027/1117.htm' is titled '2026 Chinese Government Scholarship (Scholarship for 2027 is coming soon)'; no 2027 scholarship dates found.
Website title adds '(CGS and BGS)' and 'and Scholarships'; the official site name is 'THU Graduate Admissions for International Students', so the difference is descriptive and kept.

official_title: Application Guide for Doctoral Degree Programs 2026

degrees.quote: Doctoral Degree Programs (three to four academic years); applicants must be Master's degree holders

opens.source_text: The page lists only deadlines per funding source; no opening date for the online application system is stated.

closes.source_text: Self-funded 'February 28, 2026'; CSC Type B 'December 31, 2025'; CSC Type A 'check with your country's international student dispatch department'; China Studies Program Ph.D. in China Fellowship, Zhejiang Government Scholarship, ZJU International School of Medicine Scholarship, ZJE Hai Scholarship, ZJU College of Optical Science and Engineering Scholarship 'February 28, 2026'; China-ASEAN Oceanic Scholarship 'May 31,2026'. Times are Beijing time.

notes: No 2027 doctoral guide was found (only the 2026 guide, 2024 guide and a 2027 passport-expiry requirement 'after March 1, 2027').

Page titles on the page: 'Doctoral Degree Programs', 'Application Guide for Doctoral Degree Programs 2026', 'Catalog of Chinese-taught/English-taught Doctoral Degree Programs 2026'. The website title is a descriptive grouping and is kept.

degrees.quote: Yenching Academy of Peking University Master's Program in China Studies ... two years in duration

opens.source_text: applications for the 2027 cohort of Yenching Scholars starting September 1, 2026

notes: Closing: the Admissions page gives '9:00 am Beijing time', so the instant is fixed; the website currently shows date only (30 November 2026, no time). The home page (yenchingacademy.pku.edu.cn) itself states 'November 30, 2026' without time.

Degrees: the website's degrees_now is empty. The official 2026-entry page (29 October 2025) calls it a 'Master's Program in China Studies' (two years). The 2027 Admissions page itself does not use the word master's, and applicants need 'a minimum of a Bachelor's degree'.

Title: official pages never use 'Yenching Academy Scholarship'. They use 'Yenching Academy of Peking University Master's Program in China Studies' (programme) and 'Yenching Fellowship' (funding, covers the first academic year plus a second-year Yenching Fellowship); 'Yenching Scholars' for students. 'Yenching Fellowship' is the scholarship name; alternative acceptable title: 'Yenching Academy of Peking University Master's Program in China Studies (Yenching Fellowship)'. Judgement call for the caller.

HMT (Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan) route for the previous intake closed 12:00 noon on January 9, 2026; the 2027 HMT deadline was not retrieved. Applicants from mainland China follow separate PKU Graduate School guidance.
No separate 2027 international instruction page was found; the 2025 and 2026 instruction pages exist.

degrees.quote: Schwarzman Scholars is a prestigious one-year, fully funded master's program in global affairs at Tsinghua University.

opens.phrase: April 2027 (U.S. and global applicants); March 2027 (Chinese citizens)
opens.source_text: Application Period: Apr 2027 - Sep 2027 for U.S. and Global applicants; Mar 2027 - May 2027 for applicants with Chinese citizenship (Mainland, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan). Program begins Aug 2028.

closes.source_text: Only month ranges are given (application period ends Sep 2027 for U.S./Global; May 2027 for Chinese citizens); no exact closing date or time is published.

notes: Opens: the page gives different months by route (Apr 2027 for U.S./Global, Mar 2027 for Chinese citizens), so route_dependent; the website's 'Apr 2027' is the U.S./Global start only. If you prefer a single value, use month 'Apr 2027' with a note on the Chinese-citizen route.

Selection cycle: Oct-Nov 2027 (U.S./Global), Jun-Jul 2027 (Chinese citizenship). The admissions page does not state degree level; the home page and about page do ('one-year master's in global affairs').
